description: This is a PHP class file defining the class AOS_Products_Quotes, which extends from AOS_Products_Quotes_sugar. It includes methods for saving related line items, marking lines as deleted, and saving the object itself within the context of SuiteCRM. The file also contains licensing and copyright notices.

classes.name: AOS_Products_Quotes
classes.description: A class representing product-quote relationships in SuiteCRM, extending from a base sugar class, with added functionality for managing quote lines and deletion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: save_lines
methods.description: Processes submitted form data to create, update, or delete line items associated with a quote.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current object, performing additional setup via perform_aos_save before invoking parent save.

methods.name: mark_lines_deleted
methods.description: Marks all line items linked to a parent bean as deleted.
